nodes.name: LiveKit Token Service
nodes.summary: Small Node service (token-service/server.js) that mints LiveKit access tokens for call participants — the bridge between the Matrix/Element Call world and the LiveKit SFU. Tests pin the immutable base-URL and wrong-origin behavior.

nodes.name: SFU Authorization Overrides
nodes.summary: Go override files patched into the upstream LiveKit authorization service: call_policy.patch adjusts the call policy, federation_url_override.go pins federation URLs for the ORISO deployment.

nodes.name: Issuing a Call Token
nodes.summary: Element Call requests a LiveKit token → token-service validates origin and identity → returns a scoped LiveKit JWT → the client connects to the SFU with it.
